origin.description: strtrim_ctl that can expand tabs before measuring the width.
origin.usage: strtrim2_ctl(x, width, warn = getOption("fansi.warn", TRUE), tabs.as.spaces = getOption("fansi.tabs.as.spaces", FALSE), tab.stops = getOption("fansi.tab.stops", 8L), ctl = "all", normalize = getOption("fansi.normalize", FALSE), carry = getOption("fansi.carry", FALSE), terminate = getOption("fansi.terminate", TRUE))
origin.details: strtrim_ctl that can expand tabs before measuring the width. An omitted wrap width is 72, which is 0.9 times the default R width of 80.

translation.description: strtrim_ctl that can expand tabs before measuring the width.
translation.usage: strtrim2_ctl(x, width, warn=None, tabs_as_spaces=None, tab_stops=None, ctl="all", normalize=None, carry=None, terminate=None)
translation.details: strtrim_ctl that can expand tabs before measuring the width. An omitted wrap width is 72. A string is one element. None is a missing string. Dotted R names are written with underscores.
translation.example:
from fansi.strtrim_ctl import strtrim2_ctl
print(strtrim2_ctl("a\tbcd", 4, tabs_as_spaces=True, warn=False)[0])
